standard_prerequisites: faithful flatness characterized by flatness plus surjectivity of the induced map on spectra over an ideal of definition
localization of adic rings at f and the corresponding local diagrams
naive rig-flatness as the local form of rig-flatness, and descent of flatness along faithfully flat ring maps
core_obligations: Prove that in a commutative diagram A -> B over A -> A' with B -> B' faithfully flat and all arrows adic topologically finite type, if the base-changed map varphi' : A' -> B' is rig-flat, then varphi : A -> B is rig-flat
proof_roadmap: Rig-flatness is checked after localizing at each f in A, and the hypotheses (flatness of A -> A', faithful flatness of B -> B') are preserved by localization.
It suffices to prove naive rig-flatness of varphi, i.e., flatness of the local maps.
The base-changed map is naively rig-flat and Spec(B') -> Spec(B) is surjective, so flatness of the local map descends along the faithfully flat cover, giving naive rig-flatness of varphi.
difficulty_reason: H3: a descent argument for flatness along a faithful flat cover after localization.
